summary: A Depth subscription on an equity: Nubra's order-book message gives LTP, volume and the book padded to five levels; a message with no resting orders clears the book.

deviations.reason: Nubra's messages carry no trade time; the desktop sends its receipt time as ltt (NubraFeed leaves last_trade_time_ms 0, feed::bridge::ltt falls back to the tick's timestamp), the web sends no ltt. A receipt time must not pass as a trade time (audit P-08).
The web stamps Nubra frames with the message's own timestamp (obj.timestamp, receipt time only when it is 0); the desktop stamps its receipt time (audit P-08, still open).

Nubra's order book carries no last quantity; the desktop's Depth frame sends it as 0 (NubraFeed marks nothing absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out (web openalgo#2376).

Nubra's order book carries no average price; the desktop's Depth frame sends it as 0 (NubraFeed marks nothing absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out (web openalgo#2376).

Nubra's order book carries no open; the desktop's Depth frame sends it as 0 (NubraFeed marks nothing absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out (web openalgo#2376).

Nubra's order book carries no high; the desktop's Depth frame sends it as 0 (NubraFeed marks nothing absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out (web openalgo#2376).

Nubra's order book carries no low; the desktop's Depth frame sends it as 0 (NubraFeed marks nothing absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out (web openalgo#2376).

Nubra's order book carries no close; the desktop's Depth frame sends it as 0 (NubraFeed marks nothing absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out (web openalgo#2376).

Nubra's order book carries no oi; the desktop's Depth frame sends it as 0 (NubraFeed marks nothing absent), the web leaves it out. A field the stream does not carry must be left out (web openalgo#2376).
As oi (the desktop also sends open_interest beside oi; lead rule 2026-11-09: follows the web adapter).

Both pad a short side to five levels; the web's padding levels carry price 0 (an integer), the desktop's 0.0. Lead rule 2026-11-09: number types follow the web adapter; lane wire to settle padded books for every broker.
